items.stem: Select the CORRECTLY matched pair regarding connective tissue:
options: B) Adipose tissue — Dense connective tissue
C) Areolar tissue — Loose connective tissue
items.answer: C) Areolar tissue — Loose connective tissue
items.explanation: Areolar and Adipose are Loose Connective Tissues; Tendon is Dense Regular CT; Cartilage is Supportive CT.

items.stem: Which of the following cell types secretes histamine, serotonin, and heparin in loose connective tissue?
items.explanation: Mast cells produce histamine (inflammatory mediator), heparin (anticoagulant), and serotonin.
